title: Post Turing: Mapping the landscape of LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper reviews literature on modeling human evaluation (LLM-as-a-judge) and notes that evaluator models like GPT-4 exhibit vocabulary bias by systematically preferring their own generated text over human-generated text.

The paper highlights that when using superior LLMs (like GPT-4) to conduct blind, side-by-side comparisons of model outputs, the evaluator models demonstrate specific positional biases based on the order the text is presented.
